title: Members already in a gym are never asked the 18+ and terms tick, not even when the terms change
what: The '18 or older and I agree to the terms' box was added on 21 Oct and is asked only on the join screen and on the sign-in screens. A member who joined before it existed never ticked it, and the app never asks them. When the terms version is raised so that 'every member must tick again', the new tick is checked only on the sign-in screens, which a member who is already in a gym does not see again, so existing members are never asked.
expected: A member already in a gym who has no tick for the current terms is asked once, for example when the Gym tab opens, before the app goes on.
how_often: every member who joined before 21 Oct, and every member after each terms change
fix_line: Ask members already in a gym for the tick once, when the app finds no tick for the current terms.

title: Members who joined before 'busy times by exercise' start sharing which machines they use when their gym turns it on, with no word
what: 'Share which machines I use' is on by default, and that default also applies to phones updated from older versions that never had the setting. When the gym owner turns on busy times by exercise, every member's phone starts sending the day, the hour and the gym machines of its last 35 days of workouts. A member who joined before the feature existed never saw anything about it, and nothing on screen tells them it has started. The switch to stop it is under Settings, What my gym can see.
expected: A member who joined before the feature is told once, the first time their gym turns it on, and can say no before anything is sent.
how_often: once per gym that turns the feature on, for every member already in it
fix_line: Show existing members a one-time note with an on or off choice before their phone shares machine use.

items.reason: Update is safe both ways: a new app on an old server retries without the new argument, and old apps keep working because new server arguments have defaults; saved gym, inbox and shop data are read field by field; the pinned icon is redrawn after an update; the push address is saved again weekly; old messages do not pop up after an update; old link addresses still open. Moving to a new phone or package loses the gym link (existing findings). No watch part and no web page cache in this area.

Plan end: Plus lock can be dodged by setting the date back, and an owed fee disappears after 7 days (existing). Six months away: kept membership shows old days left (existing); an invite link waits 7 days; an offline leave is resent at every start. Staff who leave keep nothing (no session or PIN is saved). Day sums use calendar dates, so leap day and year end are safe; the monthly challenge month is decided on the server. Member leaves and returns or changes phone: a second member (existing). No trial in this area.
New-only flows: the 18+ and terms tick (join only), trainer sharing switched on at join, the join day for trainer sharing, the welcome. Reverse case: machine sharing is on for old members too.
Older phones get the gym's start date for trainer sharing (F218); old members can switch trainer sharing on in Settings. No path asks existing members for the terms tick.
Terms tick has no path for existing members (01); machine sharing starts for old members with no word (02).
A new install or new member gets no pop-ups for old messages; the bell and the 'New' tag on message threads come from the server's unread state per member; no What's new dots in this area.
Only after a rejoin: the welcome as if new, and old messages unread again (existing findings). Nothing new found.
